what: How many of the public replay's G flags (Developer Flow merge requests, the agent's own version) are tests deleted together with a feature flag: a `tests_removed` extra whose removed lines name a flag whose definition (config/feature_flags/**/<name>.yml) the same diff deletes. Found after labelling (fleet 8, P1), not pre-registered; the rules are not changed by it. Reads only the replay's cache (eval/cache/gitlab/).
